text:
Liam (AE): Quick heads-up — customer (FinServ APAC) wants APAC-only data residency for the POC. They also want EU fallback disabled. Can we confirm which sub-processors we use in APAC and whether routing policy can force APAC region only? Need impact on pricing for Dedicated in ap-southeast-1. POC target next week. @Priya

Priya (Solutions): @Liam yes — we have Dedicated + Private options. APAC-only routing is supported by per-tenant routing policy. For hosted API we can set region preference but not strict enforcement unless Dedicated/Private is used.

Marco (Infra): For Dedicated/Private we can pin to ap-southeast-1. Current APAC sub-processors I know of: GCP Singapore (storage), our local partner (compute). Monitoring/telemetry currently ships to central ingest (us-east-1) unless disabled — follow-up required.

Eve (Security): Monitoring in us-east-1 is only for aggregated telemetry. For PII/regulatory customers we can disable telemetry ingest and route logs to customer-managed KMS. We'll need to fill the sec questionnaire with sub-processor details and SOC2 statements.

Liam (AE): They also asked about price delta for Dedicated in ap-southeast-1 for a 1 VPC + 2-GPU config, and whether burst to other regions is allowed. Any ballpark?

Priya (Solutions): Ballpark: Dedicated regional premium typically +18–25% vs our US-west baseline due to infra supply. I'll confirm exact numbers with Finance. If tenant is pinned, burst to other regions is blocked; fallback only if the routing policy allows it.

Marco (Infra): example routing policy we use for strict regional enforcement:
```json
{"routing": {"mode": "strict", "preferred_regions": ["ap-southeast-1"], "fallback": []}}
```
strict = no cross-region fallback; preferred with empty fallback forbids any routing outside the list.

Eve (Security): For the questionnaire, include sub-processors list (draft):
- GCP Singapore (storage)
- Local partner SG (compute)
- (optional) S3/us-east-1 (monitoring, opt-out for Private)
We should also attach our DPA addendum for sub-processor consent.

RedwoodOpsBot: NOTE: Dedicated allocation in ap-southeast-1 estimated 48–72h after signed commit. SLA applies once provisioned.

Liam (AE): OK — action items: 1) Priya confirm pricing delta 2) Marco confirm monitoring opt-out + concrete sub-processor FQDNs 3) Eve provide security text for questionnaire & KMS flow 4) Ops confirm provisioning SLA. POC start tentative next Mon. Thanks :pray:

Priya (Solutions): I'll ping Finance and loop back within 4 hours.

Marco (Infra): Pinging partners now, will post subproc FQDNs (storage.compute.example.sg) when confirmed.

Eve (Security): I'll draft the sec questionnaire answers and include KMS diagram + wording for telemetry opt-out.

Liam (AE): Great — looping in the customer contact internally for visibility. I'll share this thread in the customer thread after we have numbers.
